The median is used because the mean is pulled up by the largest APTOS captures. Covers the whole per-case path a deployment runs, quality gate and preprocessing included, not the forward pass alone. deferralRate.source: SCENARIO VALUE, NOT THE MEASURED ONE. Retained at 0.10 as a planning figure for a decision policy that can act autonomously. The current pipeline cannot: measured over the full validation split with eval/ablationHarness.m (configuration A5, n=550, results/20260824_033628_ablation_A1_A5), autonomous coverage is 0.000 and every case escalates, so the measured deferral rate is 1.00 (see measuredDeferralRate). grade.decisionPolicy raises required-evidence-unknown, unknown-neovascularisation-status, candidate-evidence-provisional and rule-engine-recommends-escalation on every image while the only evidence source is classical microaneurysm candidate detection, and those codes force escalation before any threshold is read. Any sweep run at 0.10 therefore models a hypothetical improved policy, not the system as it stands, and must be labelled that way when quoted.

referablePrevalence.source: Retained at 0.10 as a screening-population planning value. Deliberately NOT set to the 0.41 referable fraction of the APTOS test split: APTOS is a competition dataset enriched for disease, not a screening cohort, and using its prevalence would badly distort the workload model.

measuredDeferralRate.source: Measured 24 Aug 2026 over the validation split (n=550) with eval/ablationHarness.m configuration A5 at the frozen operating point. Autonomous coverage 0 of 550.
